(Search snippet content — full article 403'd on direct fetch; IEA's own statement language, 15 October 2026)

The IEA Governing Board noted the IEA Secretariat's most recent assessments, which point to continued tightness in oil markets, notably for diesel.
Approximately 330 million barrels have so far been released and the board agreed to take all necessary steps to complete the remaining releases of around 100 million barrels in a timely manner consistent with national circumstances.
The IEA Governing Board agreed to accelerate the release of remaining volumes, with specific plans already in place, including over 20 million barrels of diesel as soon as possible.
